correctness.rationale: Bao's stated rank criteria immediately force total rank at most two whenever the E2 rank-one contribution is from Theorem 1.3(c)(i). For the Example 6.3 parameter family, exact algebra gives component ranks (1,1,0): the E1 cube condition holds, the E2 case-(i) cube identities hold, and the E3 square-root condition fails. The nonsquare claim for m is proved modulo 8, and exact symbolic substitution verifies two explicit independent component-derived sections on E0.

originality.rationale: Searches for arXiv:2609.16349, Bao's Example 6.3, the parameter 32n^3-1, and equivalent rank-two/rank-three formulations found no prior correction or follow-up. Internal repository searches found no overlapping record. The source preprint is only days old, so originality remains to the best of our knowledge and an unindexed contemporaneous correction is the main residual risk.

value.rationale: The result identifies a structural impossibility in the maximal-rank mechanism, corrects an infinite family from claimed rank three to exact rank two, removes an unnecessary squarefreeness restriction for the corrected family, and supplies explicit independent sections.
